DiagnosticService-
GenericMapping
, then the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall use the in-
stance of the
ara::diag::GenericUDSService
class referenced by the
Di-
agnosticServiceGenericMapping
and call its
ara::diag::GenericUDSSer-
vice::HandleMessage
method with
sid
parameter set to 0x22 and
requestData
parameter set to the
id
of the
DiagnosticDataIdentifier

⌋
The application realizing the
ara::diag::GenericUDSService::HandleMes-
sage
is in the responsibility of a serialization/deserialization of UDS parameters. That
means no data typed elements are provided as UDS input/output parameters.
